text: Polylane needs a product-level corpus, because its current self-audit proves the harness but not vague-idea-to-usable-app performance.
Discovery choices must be persisted as typed nodes and edges so resume does not depend on transcript memory.
Cheap deterministic gates should run before Codex fan-out, and worker context should be explicitly bounded.
Quality loops should be typed, bounded, replayable, and visible instead of implemented as unbounded retry prose.
Prompt and skill recommendations should learn only from reproducible downstream outcomes.
The operator surface should be a projection of canonical event and goal state rather than a second state machine.
